Maya (Finance): Quick ping — monthly GPU allocation is showing ~18% untagged for Feb. Need owners to confirm mappings before I close the books.
Jasper (Infra): Noted. I think untagged are from the new spot nodepool we rolled on 02/20. We missed the startup script that sets project tags.
Priya (ML Eng): Confirmed — several training batches (job IDs: train-2026-02-22-07, train-2026-02-23-14) ran on that pool. We didn't pass the billing tags via kube annotations.
Maya (Finance): Can you both list the affected teams/customers? I need to reassign to correct cost centers. Also how big is the delta in dollars?
CostBot: monthly_gpu_summary: total_gpu_hours=3,842; tagged_hours=3,152; untagged_hours=690; est_untagged_cost=$8,970
Jasper (Infra): That matches my logs — approx 680-700 hours. Likely split: infra-experiments (60%), ml-training (40%).
Priya (ML Eng): If 40% is ML training, that's ~272 hours -> around $3,500. Customers impacted: private-beta-custA for some runs, internal-experiments for the rest.
Liam (ProdOps): FYI we have a large tib-training load test scheduled for 03/01 that will use the same pool. Can we gate it until tagging is fixed?
Jasper (Infra): Agreed. I'll patch the startup script to inject: `billing_tag=team:$TEAM,billing_code:$COST_CENTER` and redeploy nodes. ETA 2 hrs.
Maya (Finance): Awesome. Once patched, can you backfill tags for the windows 02/20-02/24? We need to update GL before month close.
Jasper (Infra): I'll run a backfill task to match kube event logs -> instance usage. It will output CSV like `instance_id,created_at,job_id,assigned_owner`
Priya (ML Eng): I can provide a mapping of job IDs -> customer codes. Sending that now: `train-2026-02-22-07 -> custA-ML`, `train-2026-02-23-14 -> internal-ml`
Maya (Finance): Perfect. After backfill please DM the CSV. I'll import into our cost system and issue corrected allocation for Feb.
Liam (ProdOps): Can we add a budget alert for untagged GPU spend > $2k/month? Catch these sooner.
Maya (Finance): Good call — @CostBot any chance to add a daily untagged alert to #finance for > $500/day?
CostBot: alert_rule_created: scope=finance,metric=untagged_gpu_cost,threshold=$500/day,channel=#finance
Maya (Finance): Thanks — closing this thread once backfill complete. :thumbsup:
